observations.observation: Forest-green shade and base now use broad painted patches and visible restrained brush description. Both cylindrical supports and entire oval base remain fully visible.
Title, English product name and both descriptions occupy left page; paragraph now substantially larger and clearly adjoining the lamp-lit surface.
Event name, date, time and place are larger than explanatory and visit text. They follow left-page explanation along adjacent book spread.
Visit conditions, bringing-book instruction and URL are grouped but remain noticeably small relative to date/place; reading the long visit sentence still needs close attention.
Lamp still forms first pictorial anchor. Left-page title and center event form two readable graphic anchors linked by book; detailed copy is below thumbnail reading scale.
Copy strings visually read once, upright mature Korean serif structure with stable counters, proportional Latin/dates. Typographic lines remain slightly angled with the book planes.
Supports are visibly connected at shade/base; lamp rests on desktop. Lit page field and warm contact shadows remain coherent.
